query: SELECT e.canonical_uri,e.source_id,s.introduced_by FROM discovery_entries e JOIN discovery_sources s ON s.id=e.source_id WHERE e.kind IN ('profile','community','video') AND (e.kind<>'community' OR $1) AND (e.kind<>'video' OR $2) AND e.state<>'withdrawn' AND s.enabled AND s.valid_until>clock_timestamp() AND e.valid_until<=clock_timestamp()+interval '1 hour' AND e.updated_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '23 hours' ORDER BY e.valid_until,e.id LIMIT 64
